notes: Identity independently checked: supplied excerpt identifies The Stability of Working Memory: Do Previous Tasks Influence Complex Span?, M. Karl Healey, Lynn Hasher, Elena Danilova, Journal of Experimental Psychology: General, 2011, 140(4), 573–585, DOI 10.1037/a0024587 (L0–5, L63–79). This is a parsed primary report explicitly incomplete through PDF page 5. No PDF supplied; no acquisition attempted. Target matched by Experiment 1 label and ignore-words/operation-span procedure, not row order or numeric values. Supplied p. 5 locator begins Experiment 2; Experiment 1 results are on PDF p. 4 / printed p. 576. Reverse-digit span and response inhibition from broader neutral description are not Experiment 1 outcomes here; the matching working-memory outcome is operation span. N=38 is directly printed and explicitly final after exclusions; no sum or df inference used. Cohen’s d is explicitly defined. Canonical parse maps equals signs to U+0001 in statistical expressions; test_statistic normalizes that separator only. Same-test p text prints .001 preceded by U+0005, an unreadable operator. Its bound cannot be verified without the absent PDF; p remains null rather than treating .001 as exact or guessing the bound. Unassigned original and reported_success fields are placeholders only.
